headlines.description: DeMar DeRozan scored 31 points and Kyle Lowry added 20 to help the Toronto Raptors win their fourth straight game, 123-114 over the Philadelphia 76ers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raptors roll past 76ers 123-114 for 4th straight victory

headlines.description: John Wall and Bradley Beal combined for 19 of their 45 points in the third quarter, Washington's highest-scoring period of the season, and the Wizards came back to beat the Hornets 109-106.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wall, Beal help Wizards top Hornets 109-106 with big 3rd

headlines.description: Austin Rivers made seven 3-pointers and scored 25 points in his return from a concussion to help the Clippers beat the Magic 113-108 on Wednesday night for their third straight straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Clippers hold off Magic 113-108 for third straight win
